statement: A smooth surface metric with no local isometric immersion in ℝ<sup>3</sup>. Constructs a smooth positive-definite metric on $`(-1,1)^2`$ for which no neighborhood of the origin admits a smooth isometric immersion into ℝ<sup>3</sup>. This answers the unrestricted smooth local isometric realization problem for surfaces negatively, even after shrinking the neighborhood.
